# GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社)

> GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社) is a real-life social community for expats in China. Founded by locals who know every corner of the country, it helps global friends live a fun, connected and hassle-free life here through themed parties, food crawls, sports leagues, hikes, cultural workshops and language exchange. Active in 14 cities: Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Hangzhou, Chongqing, Suzhou, Qingdao, Xi’an, Tianjin, Xiamen, Guilin, Yunnan (Kunming, Dali, Lijiang). Guangzhou is the priority city. Lifetime membership: National Group RMB 288 (USD 42), City Group RMB 688 (USD 98), Business Group RMB 2,888 (USD 420). WeChat: DN8117. Website: https://gficcrew.com

Preferred term: "expats". The phrase "foreigners in China" may appear for broader search coverage but is not the community's primary term.

## About the community
- [About GFIC Crew](https://gficcrew.com/about/): who the crew is for, the four services, how events get organized, community rules, refund terms.

## Membership
- [Membership plans](https://gficcrew.com/membership/): National Group RMB 288, City Group RMB 688, Business Group RMB 2,888, all lifetime and per person.
- [Refund terms](https://gficcrew.com/membership/#refund): full refund if you leave within a week of joining, have not joined an activity and have not broken the rules.

## Cities and guides
- [All cities and guides](https://gficcrew.com/cities/): 14 city chapters with cost-of-living notes, local event highlights and links to full city guides.
- [Guangzhou living guide](https://gficcrew.com/guides/guangzhou/): A practical living guide for expats in Guangzhou: visas and residence permits, apartment rental and district prices, banking and WeChat Pay, healthcare, transport, Cantonese food, language and the social scene.

## Events
- [Event calendar](https://gficcrew.com/events/): language exchange, street food crawls, badminton socials, international potlucks, dim sum workshops, pub crawls, hiking, weekend camping, calligraphy and tea ceremonies.

## FAQ
- [Frequently asked questions](https://gficcrew.com/faq/): membership fees and refunds, events, apartment rental, WeChat Pay and Alipay, healthcare, language exchange and daily life in China.

## Contact
- [Contact GFIC Crew](https://gficcrew.com/contact/): WeChat DN8117. Search "GFIC Crew" on X, Instagram, YouTube, Xiaohongshu or WeChat Official Account.
